title: Single-runner guarantee with Postgres advisory locks

user_story.i_want: to run two scheduler instances without any job running twice

description: Before a run, take a session-level `pg_try_advisory_lock` on a key derived from the job name, holding a dedicated connection from the pool for the whole run. Release it in a guard that also runs on error. If the lock is taken, the run is skipped and logged.

acceptance_criteria.then: each heartbeat minute has exactly one job_runs row

acceptance_criteria.given: the instance holding a lock is killed with -9 mid-run
acceptance_criteria.then: the other instance runs the job (the lock died with the connection)

rust_concepts: Lifetimes of a borrowed pool connection
